# Theme roles: what each role paints and what it takes

Use this when you edit a Theme (a `theme.yaml` from `chrona preset copy`) to change how a plan looks.
A Theme has three parts:

- `values`: named tokens, each `{type: ..., value: ...}` (a size, a dash pattern, a symbol, a font family).
- `roles`: per role, properties that **name a token** (`roles.planned.cornerRadius: radius.bar`).
- `colorBindings`: per role, a colour **paint** bound to a Colour Scheme intent
  (`planned.fill: accent`). Concrete colours live in the Scheme, not here.

A property a role does not take is rejected (`E_THEME_ROLE_PROPERTY_UNSUPPORTED`). A declared role that no
table row, View, Detail Profile or Layout Profile names is reported as unread (`W_THEME_ROLE_UNREAD`).

## Look-affecting switches that are easy to miss

- **Today line.** Its colour is the binding `as-of.stroke`; its dash and width are the properties of the
  **different** role `asOf` (`dash`, `strokeWidth`). A dash needs positive numbers: for a solid line remove
  `dash` from the role rather than writing `[1, 0]`.
- **Planned and actual points.** Planned milestones paint with `milestone.fill`, gates with `gate.fill` (when the
  Theme declares a `gate` role), and actual points with `actual.fill`.
- **Progress.** Progress fill appears only when the View asks for it (`progressFill: {source: actual}` or
  `planned`, which a Layout Profile can supply as `viewDefaults.progressFill`). It is painted by role
  `progress-fill` (`progress-fill.fill`) and adds a Progress key to the legend (see Legend keys).
  Remove that member from the View and the Layout Profile defaults to draw finished actuals without it.
- **Small caps.** A text role with `textTransform` set to a token of value `small-caps` also needs
  `smallCapsScale`, a number token above 0.5 and below 1. Text transforms: `none` `uppercase` `lowercase` `capitalize` `small-caps`.
- **Circles.** A `symbol` token takes `{shape: circle}`; the other shapes are `diamond` `square` `chevron`
  or a `glyph` whose path parts use only move, line, quadratic and close commands (no arcs: draw a circle with
  the shape, not with `A` commands).

## Colour bindings

A binding key is `<role>.<paint>` where the paint is one of `fill` `stroke` `gradientStart` `gradientEnd` `shadowColor` `glowColor`. Its value is a Scheme intent:

`surface` `surfaceRaised` `text` `textMuted` `accent` `positive` `negative` `warning` `neutral` `insideLabelPlanned` `insideLabelActual` `insideLabelSnapshot` `insideLabelScenario` `rule`, or `category:<slot>` for a named category slot of the Scheme.

## Roles

113 registered roles. *Paints* is the meaning the semantic vocabulary gives the role. *Colour* lists
the paints that take a Scheme intent. *Tokens* lists the properties that name a token (see the property table).
*Effects* says the role also takes gradient, shadow, glow, wobble or stroke cap and join properties.

| `variance-on-track` | label `table-cell`; label `finish-delta`; label `forecast-finish-delta` | `.fill` | `contrastTreatment` `opacity` | gradient, shadow, glow |

### Generated role names

A Theme may also declare names under these prefixes.

- `group:...`: one colour per group, chosen by the View's group colouring
- `period-band:...`: a named period's band, one role per period slug
- `period-label:...`: a named period's label, one role per period slug
- `region-frame-...`: a region frame painted by `frame.paint` (the slug after the dash)
- `frame-glyph...`: a catalogue border run on a region frame
- `annotation-artwork...`: an annotation container's artwork layer

## Role properties

| Property | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | closed set (see the Theme schema) | Block alignment for offset-free role geometry: start, center (the default), or end. |
| `annotationContainer` | a token name from `values` | Named outline/tail-geometry token for an annotation-box role; absent keeps today's plain rectangle. |
| `artworkFidelity` | a token name from `values` | Named fidelity token (required or decorative-optional) for the annotation-artwork role: whether a profile that cannot paint the artwork's stroked parts fails or omits it whole. |
| `backgroundPaintOrder` | integer | Finite completed ordering key for a review-surface background role. |
| `backgroundTreatment` | `fill` `outline` `none` | Finite treatment for a completed review-surface background role; none is an explicit non-drawable disposition. |
| `barBleed` | closed set (see the Theme schema) | Annotation-kind bar extent: none (runtime default) stays within content insets; border reaches the container's inner border edges. |
| `barWidth` | closed set (see the Theme schema) | Annotation-kind bar inline sizing: fill (runtime default) spans the inner container; hug uses measured bar text and padding. |
| `blockGap` | a token name from `values` | Named nonnegative pixel gap below a heading kicker; admitted only on kicker. |
| `cellCornerChamfer` | a token name from `values` | Named ratio, of the cell block size (0 &lt; ratio &lt;= 0.5), of the cut at each corner of every cell of an axis band tier; excludes cellCornerRadius and a pattern; absent keeps square corners. |
| `cellCornerRadius` | a token name from `values` | Named ratio, of the cell block size (0 &lt; ratio &lt;= 0.5), of the arc radius of the corners of every cell of an axis band tier; absent keeps square corners. |
| `cellGap` | a token name from `values` | Named gap in px between adjacent cells of an axis band tier. |
| `chipMinBlockSize` | a token name from `values` | Named length in px: the smallest block size of a &lt;purpose>-chip label chip; a shorter chip grows equally above and below its text. |
| `chipPadding` | a token name from `values` | Named label-chip padding ratio of the label's font size (inline; half on the block axis) for a &lt;purpose>-chip role. |
| `chipShape` | a token name from `values` | Named chipShape token: rectangle (the default), a text-fitting burst, or a catalogue nine-slice outline. |
| `coneExtent` | a token name from `values` | Named as-of cone extent token: depth of the foot as a fraction of the plot height, 0 &lt; extent &lt;= 1. |
| `coneSpread` | a token name from `values` | Named as-of cone spread token: half-width gained per unit of depth, 0 &lt; spread &lt;= 4. |
| `contrastTreatment` | `required` `deemphasized` | Finite contrast-floor treatment for a classified state-text role. |
| `cornerRadius` | a token name from `values` | Named radius token overriding this role's legacy radius with physical px or capsule. |
| `dash` | a token name from `values` | Named dash-pattern token for the role. |
| `doubleRuleGap` | a token name from `values` | Named positive physical clear gap between the strokes of a double named-period edge rule. |
| `edgeRules` | a token name from `values` | Selected per-edge rules for a named-period band; omission retains its legacy Rect outline. |
| `fontFamily` | a token name from `values` | Named font-family token for the role. |
| `fontSize` | a token name from `values` | Named font-size token for the role. |
| `fontWeight` | a token name from `values` | Named font-weight token for the role. |
| `frameCornerRadius` | a token name from `values` | Named corner-radius token (px, at least 0) of a region frame; reduced to half the shorter side when larger. |
| `glowBlur` | a token name from `values` | Named glow blur token (standard deviation in px, at most 64). |
| `glowFidelity` | a token name from `values` | Named glow fidelity token. |
| `glowOpacity` | a token name from `values` | Named glow opacity token. |
| `glyphPitch` | a token name from `values` | Named physical-pixel minimum centre spacing of frame-glyph marks; must be at least glyphSize and is admitted only on frame-glyph roles. |
| `glyphSize` | a token name from `values` | Named positive physical-pixel side length of each frame-glyph mark; admitted only on frame-glyph roles. |
| `gradientAngle` | a token name from `values` | Named linear-gradient angle token. |
| `gradientFidelity` | a token name from `values` | Named gradient fidelity token. |
| `horizontalScale` | a token name from `values` | Named number token, 0.5 to 1, compressing the role's text along its own inline axis; Layout measures the compressed width. |
| `iconGap` | a token name from `values` | Named typography-relative icon inline-gap ratio for the role. |
| `iconScale` | a token name from `values` | Named typography-relative icon block-size ratio for the role. |
| `inlineGap` | a token name from `values` | Named nonnegative pixel gap after an inline summary run, except the last; admitted on summary-caption, metric and summary-unit. |
| `labelGap` | a token name from `values` | Named gap, as a ratio of the role's font size, between an axis label and its secondary label: below it when stacked, after it when inline; absent, 0 when stacked and one measured space when inline. |
| `labelInset` | a token name from `values` | Named inset as a ratio of the role's font size: a start-aligned axis label from its cell edge, or a horizontal groupHeader from its header band start. |
| `labelInsetEnd` | a token name from `values` | Named nonnegative ratio of groupHeader font size added after drawn text to its text-sized band, clamped to the table column. |
| `laneBlockSize` | a token name from `values` | Named axis-lane block size in px for a labels tier's typography role; the tier becomes a declared lane with vertically centred labels. |
| `letterSpacing` | a token name from `values` | Named em-based letter-spacing number token measured by Layout. |
| `lineHeight` | a token name from `values` | Named line-height token for the role. |
| `markCornerRadius` | a token name from `values` | Named mark corner-radius ratio for this semantic role. |
| `markHeight` | a token name from `values` | Named lane-slot-relative mark block-size ratio for this semantic role. |
| `markOffset` | a token name from `values` | Named lane-slot-relative mark block-start ratio for this semantic role. |
| `markPaintOrder` | a token name from `values` | Named completed mark paint-order value for this semantic role. |
| `markReach` | a token name from `values` | Named ratio of the planned mark's block size that a deadline tick spans, centred on that mark (0 &lt; ratio &lt;= 4); above 1 the tick stands above and below the bar. |
| `marker` | a token name from `values` | Named marker token for the role. |
| `numericSpacing` | a token name from `values` | Named finite numeric-spacing token selected before Layout measurement. |
| `opacity` | a token name from `values` | Named opacity token for the role. |
| `outlineWidth` | a token name from `values` | Named nonnegative physical-pixel outline margin around deadline tick/run ink. |
| `pattern` | a token name from `values` | Named pattern token for the role. |
| `patternMode` | `ink-only` | Canvas texture mode; absent preserves the opaque substrate-and-ink behavior, ink-only removes its substrate. |
| `pointSwatchSize` | a token name from `values` | Named absolute side of the point (gate, milestone) legend swatch. |
| `progressInset` | a token name from `values` | Named progress-track inset ratio of the host mark's block size; the fill sits inside the track with this gap (0 &lt;= ratio &lt; 0.5). |
| `radialCenterBlock` | a token name from `values` | Named canvas-relative radial center fraction on the block axis. |
| `radialCenterInline` | a token name from `values` | Named canvas-relative radial center fraction on the inline axis. |
| `radialInnerStop` | a token name from `values` | Named radial transparent-stop fraction in [0, 1). |
| `radialRadiusBlock` | a token name from `values` | Named positive canvas-relative radial radius fraction on the block axis. |
| `radialRadiusInline` | a token name from `values` | Named positive canvas-relative radial radius fraction on the inline axis. |
| `shadowBlur` | a token name from `values` | Named shadow blur token. |
| `shadowFidelity` | a token name from `values` | Named shadow fidelity token. |
| `shadowOffsetX` | a token name from `values` | Named shadow horizontal-offset token. |
| `shadowOffsetY` | a token name from `values` | Named shadow vertical-offset token. |
| `shadowOpacity` | a token name from `values` | Named shadow opacity token. |
| `smallCapsScale` | a token name from `values` | Named number token, above 0.5 and below 1: the scale of the role size at which a `small-caps` role sets its former lowercase letters as capitals; required with, and only admitted beside, a `textTransform` of `small-caps`. |
| `stampPlacement` | a token name from `values` | Named stampPlacement token (column corner or bar-end placement, and size) for the annotation-kind stamp role. |
| `strokeAlign` | `inside` `center` `outside` | Position of the stroke relative to a closed symbol or box contour. |
| `strokeFinishFidelity` | a token name from `values` | Named stroke-finish fidelity token. |
| `strokeLineCap` | a token name from `values` | Named stroke-cap token. |
| `strokeLineJoin` | a token name from `values` | Named stroke-join token. |
| `strokeWidth` | a token name from `values` | Named stroke-width token for the role. |
| `swatchBlockSize` | a token name from `values` | Named absolute block length of an area (background) legend swatch; declaring it makes the area swatch a rectangle of swatchInlineSize (else the legacy side) by this size. |
| `swatchGap` | a token name from `values` | Named absolute distance from a legend swatch to its label; the legend slot gap stays the distance between entries. |
| `swatchInlineSize` | a token name from `values` | Named absolute inline length for a legend swatch whose on-chart length has no single value (a span, line, or decoration key); absent means Layout falls back to the legend label's own font size. |
| `swatchShape` | closed set (see the Theme schema) | Optional default legend-key geometry for every key, including generated colour-scale keys; a Detail entry's swatchShape overrides it. |
| `symbol` | a token name from `values` | Named point-symbol token for the role. |
| `symbolHeight` | a token name from `values` | Named lane-slot-relative block-size ratio of this role's point-mark symbol (a gate or milestone), separate from the role's bar band. |
| `symbolOffset` | a token name from `values` | Named lane-slot-relative block offset ratio of this role's point-mark symbol, separate from markOffset. |
| `tabBlockSize` | a token name from `values` | Named length in px of a header-target group tab's block extent from the header's block start; absent means the full header block size. |
| `tabGap` | a token name from `values` | Named length in px between a header tab and its text, or the all-side inset of a tag-target plate; absent means 0. |
| `tabInlineSize` | a token name from `values` | Named length in px of a header-target group tab's inline extent, standing on the inline start (or end) edge; required for a drawable header target, not used by tag targets. |
| `tabPosition` | `start` `end` | Inline edge of the header the tab stands on; absent means start. |
| `tabTarget` | `header` `tag` | Target for the group-tab Rect: header (absent, the existing header behavior) or tag (the vertical group-tag cell; requires vertical groupHeader writingMode). |
| `textTransform` | a token name from `values` | Named finite transform token applied before Layout measurement. |
| `textureFidelity` | a token name from `values` | Named fidelity token for optional ink-only canvas textures and overlays. |
| `tickLength` | a token name from `values` | Named length in px of the tick a grid-major or grid-minor tier draws at each interval start, standing on the axis rule; absent keeps the full-height line. |
| `viewerFit` | `raw` `text-follows-box` `box-follows-text` | How an annotation box role and its text absorb a viewer that lacks the measured font: raw (the default, today's output); text-follows-box pins every text line of the box to the width Layout measured; box-follows-text paints the box background to end where the viewer's text ends (a plain square, untilted, content-sized rectangle with no artwork and no end, top or bottom border). |
| `viewerFitAdjust` | `spacing` `spacingAndGlyphs` | With viewerFit text-follows-box: how the viewer stretches a line to its measured width, spacing (the default; inter-glyph gaps only) or spacingAndGlyphs (glyph outlines too). |
| `wobbleAmplitude` | a token name from `values` | Named hand-wobble amplitude token (px, in (0, 16]). |
| `wobbleFidelity` | a token name from `values` | Named hand-wobble fidelity token. |
| `wobbleSeed` | a token name from `values` | Named hand-wobble seed token (an integer in [0, 2^32)). |
| `wobbleWavelength` | a token name from `values` | Named hand-wobble wavelength token (px, in [4, 1000]). |
| `writingMode` | a token name from `values` | Named writingMode token: horizontal (absent) or vertical, a single column read top to bottom with upright CJK and sideways Latin; admitted on the group-label role only. |

## Tokens

A token is `{type: T, value: V}` in `values`; a role property names it. Token types: `number` `radius` `fontFamily` `fontWeight` `dashPattern` `marker` `pattern` `symbol` `textAlternative` `lineCap` `lineJoin` `fidelity` `textTransform` `numericSpacing` `annotationContainer` `stampPlacement` `writingMode` `chipShape`.

- `symbol`: `{shape: S}` with S one of `diamond` `circle` `square` `chevron`, or a `glyph`.
- `textTransform`: one of `none` `uppercase` `lowercase` `capitalize` `small-caps`.
- `radius`: a number of at least 0, or `capsule`.
- `dashPattern`: a list of positive numbers.

## Legend keys

A Detail Profile `legend` lists the keys you want, in order, each `{role, label}`; `label` is a literal or
`{wording: <key>}`. Role names include `planned` `actual` `milestone` `dependency` `asOf` `calendar-closed` `critical-edge` `forecast` `progressFill` `snapshot` `deadlineMark`; each has a default label under the
wording key `legend.<role>`. The renderer then **adds** keys for meanings that are drawn, so the legend can
show more than you listed:

| Key | Added when | How to leave it out |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot` (Baseline) | a baseline is drawn | `unkeyedLegendRoles: [snapshot]` |
| `deadlineMark` (Deadline) | a deadline is drawn | `unkeyedLegendRoles: [deadlineMark]` |
| `forecast` | an item has a forecast | do not draw forecasts |
| `progressFill` (Progress) | a positive progress fill is drawn and its ink differs from its mark | do not set `progressFill` in the View, or give `progress-fill` the colour of its mark |

`unkeyedLegendRoles` is a Detail Profile member (a sibling of `legend`) that takes only `snapshot` `deadlineMark`.
Naming the same role in both `legend` and `unkeyedLegendRoles` is `E_DETAIL_LEGEND_POLICY`. An explicit
`legend` entry for a defaulted role replaces the default and sets its label and order. Keys for colour
scales (`scale:...`) follow the entries.

Built-in wording keys for legend labels (en-US text; `--locale ja-JP` has its own):

- `legend.planned`: Task duration
- `legend.actual`: Actual
- `legend.milestone`: Milestone
- `legend.dependency`: Dependency
- `legend.asOf`: Today
- `legend.calendar-closed`: Non-working day
- `legend.critical-edge`: Critical dependency
- `legend.forecast`: Forecast (* estimated)
- `legend.progressFill`: Progress
- `legend.actual-ahead`: Ahead
- `legend.actual-on-track`: On track
- `legend.actual-behind`: Behind
- `legend.snapshot`: Baseline
- `legend.deadlineMark`: Deadline
- `legend.planned-plain`: Planned
- `legend.baseline`: baseline
- `legend.current-plan`: current plan
- `legend.gate`: gate
- `legend.holiday`: holiday
- `legend.plan`: Plan
- `legend.missing-actual`: Not yet observed
- `legend.missing-actual-in-progress`: In progress, not yet observed
- `legend.in-the-wings`: In the wings
- `legend.calendar-exception`: Calendar exception
- `legend.period`: Period
- `legend.depends-on`: Depends on
- `legend.other`: Other
